scope_label: organizational approach to value, flow and improvement
definition: Lean is an approach to organizing and improving work so that it delivers value with less waste and more reliable flow.
explanation: Practices may include clarifying value for the user, mapping the work, reducing unnecessary steps, using pull where appropriate, and learning from problems. The practices must fit the setting.
A single tool or cost-cutting exercise does not, by itself, establish a lean system. Look for how the work, people, and continuing improvement fit together.
